name: session-shared-unlock-capture-modern-390x844
bodyText:
Your photos stay on this phone.
WHAT
Photos you choose to take with guided capture.
WHY
To build your private progress timeline on this device.
NEVER
Never uploaded automatically, sold, or used to train AI. You can choose to share a photo. Cloud backup is not available in this build.
No faceprint or biometric template is stored. A lost phone can mean lost photos. You can withdraw anytime in Settings.
Clean skin, no makeup, hair back. Same time of day as last week.
Take photos. On device only
Not now
